subject: POC activation runway & MAP — org setup, API keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-health.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lia Chen <lia.chen@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-07-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff — getting MAP started

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — Acme Health is ready to move into a short POC to validate latency and org-level isolation.

We want the MAP to cover: org setup, API key provisioning, IP allowlist for our staging cluster, and VPC peering to our AWS account (account id 123456789012).

Can you share a proposed MAP with milestones and a target timeline? Our technical lead (Lia) is CC'd — she'll own VPC peering/network items. Procurement contact is procurement@acme-health.com.

High-level target: 2-week proof-of-concept, start as early as next week if we can get keys and allowlist in place.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of Platform Engineering
Acme Health

(Attachment: none)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-health.com>
Cc: Lia Chen <lia.chen@acme-health.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-30T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — getting MAP started

Samir — thanks for the clear ask. I've sketched a short MAP that targets a 2-week POC and includes the items you listed. Key milestones:

1) Org & service account seed (Day 0–1): create Acme tenant, assign org admins, generate initial service API key (scoped to staging).
2) IP allowlist (Day 1): confirm staging CIDR(s), apply to staging route(s).
3) VPC peering (Day 2–5): exchange peering config, test routing, update security groups.
4) Smoke tests & latency check (Day 6–9): run sample inference workload, collect latency/cost metrics.
5) Review & close (Day 10–14): run final eval, agree success criteria.

I've attached a one-sheet MAP draft for your review and a suggested timeline. Please flag any drive-by constraints (firewall windows, maintenance blackout). Also confirm the AWS account id for peering and whether you want mutual BGP or AWS-managed peering.

Next steps I propose: Lia and Neha hop on a quick 30-min call tomorrow to align on peering and IP allowlist specifics.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

(Attachment: activation_map_draft.xlsx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lia Chen <lia.chen@acme-health.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-health.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-30T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — getting MAP started (technical checklist)

Hi Samir / Lia — quick technical checklist to make the MAP actionable on day 0: 

- Org setup: we will create an org tenant for Acme; we need one admin email for SSO seed and one owner for billing. Please confirm admin@acme-health.com.
- API keys: we'll generate a scoped service API key for the POC. If you prefer ephemeral keys for each test runner, tell us the key rotation window.
- IP allowlist: please provide the staging egress CIDRs (comma-separated). We can accept single IPs or CIDR blocks; we prefer /32 entries for strictness.
- VPC peering: required info — your VPC id(s), region, AWS account id, and whether you want route table propagation. We have a peering template attached.
- DNS & routing: if you plan to use private DNS for endpoints, we'll need the hosted zone id.

Notes on timing: the fastest path is to complete org + IP allowlist on Day 1, then initiate peering (can take 24–72 hours depending on your infra team). To avoid a peering delay, we can do an interim setup using IP allowlist only and run smoke tests against the hosted staging endpoint.

Attachments: vpc_peering_template.txt, ip-allowlist.csv (example rows).

Let me know a 30-min slot for a call tomorrow morning (PST).

Thanks,
Neha
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: vpc_peering_template.txt; ip-allowlist.csv)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-health.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lia Chen <lia.chen@acme-health.com>, procurement@acme-health.com
Date: 2026-07-30T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — getting MAP started

Neha — that checklist is perfect. Quick clarifications:

- Admin email: admin@acme-health.com (SSO will be set up after we accept the invite).
- Staging CIDRs: 34.210.12.0/24, 34.210.13.0/24 (we'll provide /32s for any dedicated runners if needed).
- VPC id: vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h (us-east-1). AWS account id is correct (123456789012). We prefer AWS-managed peering (no BGP).
- Procurement: procurement team requested an estimate of any potential data egress exposure and whether logs will include customer PII. Can you confirm?

Also, procurement asked for a simple acceptance checklist and a DocuSign link for the POC SOW.

Samir

(Attachment: none)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: procurement@acme-health.com, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-health.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-30T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — procurement & SOW links

Hi Samir / procurement team — looping in procurement next steps and artifacts: 

- Short answers: our hosted POC uses tokenized request logs. We can suppress user-level PII from logs for the POC; standard retention is 30 days but we can reduce it for the pilot. No model training on customer data unless explicitly agreed.
- Estimated exposure: negligible for inference-only traffic; egress depends on payload sizes and call volume. We'll provide an estimated egress table once you share anticipated QPS and average request size.

Links and artifacts:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345 (RDW-2026-ACM-3471)
- DocuSign POC SOW (placeholder): https://docusign.com/signer/ABC-POC-SOW
- Quick acceptance checklist (internal): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDefg-map-draft

Attachment: svc-account-template.json (example service account for scoped API key provisioning).

If procurement signs off, DocuSign link will be updated with signature fields and expected to be completed same day. After signature we'll issue the scoped API key and send initial allowlist rules.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Ops, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: svc-account-template.json)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-health.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Lia Chen <lia.chen@acme-health.com>, procurement@acme-health.com
Date: 2026-08-01T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — procurement & SOW links

All — procurement signed the placeholder SOW and confirmed the staging CIDRs. We'll be ready to start the week of Aug 3. Please proceed with the MAP as drafted; Lia will run the peering tasks with Neha.

Action items I own: send signed DocuSign to Priyom, provide any ephemeral runner IPs tomorrow morning.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth run.

Samir
Director of Platform Engineering, Acme Health
(Attachment: signed_sow.pdf)
